description: Full European Medicines Agency record for one medicine, looked up by brand name or EMA product number (EMEA/H/C/...). Returns every published field: status, authorised indication, active substance, ATC code, holder, orphan / conditional / accelerated / PRIME flags, and the full date history from evaluation start through authorisation, suspension or withdrawal. Answers "what is the EU authorised indication for X", "when was X approved in Europe", "who holds the EU marketing authorisation for X".
